sanskrit_verse:
गजे नीलवृषाः पञ्च शुके वत्सो द्विहायनः ।
खराजमेषेषु वृषो देयः क्रौञ्चे त्रिहायनः ॥
transliteration: gaje nīlavṛṣāḥ pañca śuke vatso dvihāyanaḥ / kharājameṣeṣu vṛṣo deyaḥ krauñce trihāyanaḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: In the case of an elephant, five black bulls are the restitution; for a parrot, a calf aged two years; for donkeys and goats, a bull; for a heron, one aged three years.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from the intrinsic value of life-forms and their dharmic role
Causation aligns with proportional energetic disruption caused by harm
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by the offender's ability to restore balance
Restoration logic operates through equivalent-life exchange, preserving cosmic equilibrium
Consciousness alignment requires recognition of species-specific dharma in compensation
executable_legal_axioms: IF offender_capacity >= restitution_value THEN execute_restitution ELSE initiate_completion_process
supreme_court_application: This verse establishes a precedent for proportional restitutive justice based on species-dharma valuation. The Supreme Court must assess not just material loss but the metaphysical displacement caused by the act, ensuring that compensation aligns with both ecological balance and spiritual integrity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that every being carries a specific vibrational signature within its dharma. Harming it disrupts sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ). Compensation through equivalent-life exchange restores causal harmony without inflicting suffering. Responsibility is measured by capacity to realign consciousness, not inflict pain.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process: offender must witness the integration of replacement beings into their natural dharmic cycles
Responsibility assumption protocol: offender publicly acknowledges the breach and commits to dharmic learning
Capacity restoration mechanism: offender undergoes prāṇa alignment to recalibrate intentionality
Integrity reintegration cycle: community validates the restoration and supports offender's re-entry into dharmic society
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source-Authority of Dharma. Justice executed solely for restoration, reintegration, and consciousness realignment. Reality affirmed as non-punitive. Consciousness stands as the supreme adjudicator.
